definitions.gloss: just before; verge; brink; right at the moment of
definitions.explanation: The moment immediately before something happens. Indicates the very last moment or the brink of an event or deadline.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}{間際|まぎわ}に{電話|でんわ}が{鳴|な}った。
examples.english: The phone rang just as I was about to leave.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}り{間際|まぎわ}になって{慌|あわ}てて{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: I rushed to finish it right before the deadline.

examples.japanese: {死|し}ぬ{間際|まぎわ}に、{彼|かれ}は{家族|かぞく}に{最後|さいご}の{言葉|ことば}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: On the verge of death, he left his final words for his family.

notes:
Typically follows a verb in dictionary form or a noun: ～{間際|まぎわ}. Emphasizes the very last moment before something occurs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}{間際|まぎわ} (just before departure)
- {締|し}め{切|き}り{間際|まぎわ} (right before the deadline)
- {死|し}ぬ{間際|まぎわ} (on the verge of death)
- {閉店|へいてん}{間際|まぎわ} (just before closing time)

PATTERN:
- verb (dictionary form) + {間際|まぎわ} (just before doing ~)
- noun + {間際|まぎわ} (just before the ~)

Similar to {直前|ちょくぜん} (immediately before), but {間際|まぎわ} has a more vivid, moment-by-moment feeling.
